versions.name: Woodwork
versions.description: Square lumber and saw, plane and join it into something useful from working drawings you drew yourself, sharpen your own tools, and learn how timber is milled, cured and graded before it reaches the bench.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
